snippet.title: All Haul the King - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
First look at gameplay of All Haul the King. A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him.

Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4373420/All_Haul_the_King/
